parameters.name: BranchId
parameters.description: The branch ID that uniquely identifies a Supabase branch.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The Supabase project ID that corresponds to the main branch.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. This parameter is required when you create a main branch. When you create a child branch, the region is inherited from the main branch by default.
